bugs.name: No project selection resets Created by you pull-request type filter
bugs.summary: Selecting no project in Global Pull Requests resets a previously selected Created by you type filter.
bugs.expected: Clearing the project filter should preserve the selected pull-request type.
bugs.actual: Selecting no project in Global Pull Requests resets a previously selected Created by you type filter.
reproSteps: Sign in and open Global Pull Requests.
Select Created by you in Type.
Open Project and select no project or All projects.
Observe that the Type filter is reset rather than preserved.

bugs.name: Files changed summary uses plurals for single counts
bugs.summary: A pull request with one changed file and one addition shows plural nouns for both counts.
bugs.expected: The summary should say one changed file and one addition.
bugs.actual: The Files changed view says “1 changed files with 1 additions and 0 deletions.”
reproSteps: Create a pull request that adds exactly one file and one line.
Open its Files changed view at desktop width.
Read the change summary above the diff.

bugs.name: Saving with repository pull requests disabled overwrites pull-request defaults
bugs.summary: Saving with repository pull requests disabled replaced the saved pull-request defaults; the changed defaults remained after re-enabling and saving the unit.
bugs.expected: Changing only Enable repository pull requests should preserve the separately configured pull-request defaults, including the saved Create squash commit merge style and the other defaults.
bugs.actual: After saving the unit as disabled, the reopened form showed Fast-forward only, Update branch by rebase, maintainer edits enabled, branch deletion enabled, and manual-merge detection enabled instead of the previously saved values. These changes remained after re-enabling, saving, and reopening the settings.
reproSteps: Sign in as momentic-admin and create a fresh private repository.
Open repository Settings → Units → Pull requests. Note the initial defaults.
Set Default merge style to Create squash commit, save, and reopen to verify it persisted.
Disable Enable repository pull requests, save, and reopen the section.
Observe defaults changed to Fast-forward only and Update branch by rebase, with maintainer edits, branch deletion, and manual-merge detection enabled.
Re-enable pull requests, save, and reopen. Observe the changed defaults persist.

bugs.name: Merged pull request links its deleted source branch to a 404 page
bugs.summary: After merging with Delete branch checked, the source branch in the merged pull request header remains a clickable link to the removed branch. Clicking it reproducibly opens Page not found.
bugs.expected: The merged pull request should link to the retained source commit or present the deleted branch as non-clickable text so its navigation does not lead to a missing page.
bugs.actual: The bug-bash-files source link in merged pull request #5 points to /momentic-admin/field-notes/src/branch/bug-bash-files, which returns HTTP 404 and displays Page not found. Reproduced twice.
reproSteps: Sign in and open momentic-admin/field-notes.
Use Add file > New file, enter a filename and content, choose Create a new branch for this commit and start a pull request, and name it bug-bash-files.
Propose the change and create the pull request.
Open Create merge commit, check Delete branch "bug-bash-files", and confirm the merge.
On the merged pull request page, click the bug-bash-files source branch link in the header.

bugs.name: Resolving a remaining inline reply after deleting its parent returns a 500 error
bugs.summary: Resolving the remaining inline reply after deleting its parent navigates the narrow-width PR diff to a stable 500 Internal Server Error instead of resolving the conversation.
bugs.expected: The visible “Resolve conversation” action should resolve the remaining inline discussion and leave the pull-request diff usable, without an internal server error.
bugs.actual: After the parent comment was deleted and the reply remained visible, selecting “Resolve conversation” navigated to a stable 500 Internal server error page. It displayed “GetIssueByID, comment does not exist [id: 134, issue_id: 0]”; no resolved-thread summary appeared and the diff was no longer usable on that page.
reproSteps: Set the browser viewport to 390×844. Load the provided authenticated session for the repository administrator (no credentials were entered) and open /momentic-admin/field-notes/pulls.
Using the repository-administrator account momentic-admin, create and initialize a new private repository named mo-pr-comments-inline-7421 through the UI.

Create branch inline-comments-7421 from main. On that branch, create inline-comments.md with three added lines: “# Inline discussion test”, “A first added line.”, and “Line for a second thread.” Commit the file to the branch.
Create an open pull request from inline-comments-7421 into main. Open its Files changed view at /momentic-admin/mo-pr-comments-inline-7421/pulls/1/files.
On added line 3, post the ordinary inline comment “Mobile inline note.”, reply with “Reply from a narrow viewport.”, and edit that reply to “Edited from a narrow viewport.”.

Open the parent comment’s menu, choose Delete, and accept the browser confirmation. Verify that “Mobile inline note.” is gone while “Edited from a narrow viewport.” remains visible in the inline discussion.
Select “Resolve conversation” for the remaining discussion. Observe the 500 Internal server error and missing-comment message at the pull-request Files changed URL.

bugs.name: Pull requests subscription filter allows issue rows on page 2
bugs.summary: The Pull requests type filter shows issue subscriptions on page 2, including the two reported issue rows; this persisted after reselecting the filter and waiting.
bugs.expected: With Type set to Pull requests, every page of the subscription list should contain pull request subscriptions only.
bugs.actual: Page 1 showed pull requests after selecting Type > Pull requests. Page 2 then visibly included issue rows “mo-bb-project-newissue board verification 20260611-1537” and “Default-column issue on blank board.” After reselecting Pull requests and navigating to page 2 again, the issue rows appeared again and remained visible after waiting six seconds.
reproSteps: Start signed in as the admin account momentic-admin by loading the provided saved-auth session; no credentials were entered.
Open /notifications.
Click Subscriptions.
Open Type and select Pull requests; verify that the first page shows pull request rows.
Scroll to the pagination controls and select page 2.
On /notifications/subscriptions?page=2&sort=&state=all, observe the issue rows “mo-bb-project-newissue board verification 20260611-1537” and “Default-column issue on blank board.”
For a repeat check, select Type > Pull requests again, navigate to page 2, and wait six seconds; the issue rows remain visible.

bugs.name: Files changed summary counts do not match the visible PR diff
bugs.summary: The fresh private repository's PR #1 shows +2 additions and -1 deletion, while its only Files changed diff contains one added line and no deletions; the mismatch persists after refresh.
bugs.expected: The pull request summary should report +1 and -0 for a diff that adds only line 4 and deletes no lines.
bugs.actual: At 768×1024, PR #1 displayed +2 and -1 beside its Files changed tab. The only changed file's hunk showed three unchanged baseline lines and one green added line 4, with no deleted line. Refreshing left the mismatch unchanged.
reproSteps: Set the viewport to 768×1024 and use the provided authenticated session as repository administrator `momentic-admin`.
Navigate to / and create a fresh private repository named `mo-bb-inline-add-tablet-verify-2026-07-18-4c9f`, with repository initialization enabled so it has a `main` branch.
On `main`, create `inline-comments.md` containing three separate lines: `Baseline line one`, `Baseline line two`, and `Baseline line three`. Commit the file to `main`.

Edit `inline-comments.md` to append the fourth line `Added line four`. Select the option to create a branch and start a pull request, using branch `mo-bb-inline-add-tablet-feature`, and propose the change.
Create PR #1 into `main` and open its Files changed page at /momentic-admin/mo-bb-inline-add-tablet-verify-2026-07-18-4c9f/pulls/1/files.
Observe the PR summary and the only file hunk together. Refresh, wait for the page to settle, and confirm the summary remains +2/-1 while the diff still shows only one addition and no deletions.

matchingGuidance.acceptanceScope: Accepted as a valid reference by user instruction; source prerequisites and remaining evidence gaps are retained below.
prerequisites: Whitespace-insensitive visible hunk differs from raw shortstat, or historical refs differ between fetches.
